site.name: Vet Atlas
site.tagline: Open 3D veterinary anatomy, built for studying
site.disclaimer: Study material. Not a substitute for diagnosis or veterinary consultation.
site.nonCommercial: Non-commercial project. Code MIT, content CC BY-SA 4.0, third-party media under their original license.

home.title: Explore animal anatomy one structure at a time
home.lead: An open, free atlas of 3D models split into selectable pieces. Each piece with its Latin name, its description, the pathologies that affect it and how it looks in real life.

howToSteps.search: Search with <kbd>⌘K</kbd> or type a name in any language.
howToSteps.click: Tap a part of the model to open its entry.
howToSteps.layers: Use Dissection to remove skin, muscles or organs and see what lies beneath.

home.heroHint: Tap a bone in the model to open its entry.

species.stackHint: From superficial to deep. In each system you can show the others as layers.

viewer.noWebgl: Your browser cannot display 3D. You can keep reading the entries.
viewer.placeholder: Placeholder model: schematic shapes until the real scans are integrated.
viewer.hint: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, click a piece to open its entry.
viewer.sceneLabel: 3D model. Use the structure list to select with the keyboard.
viewer.loadError: We could not load the 3D model. You can keep reading the entries.
viewer.pieceHint: Drag to rotate · explode the parts to see them one by one
viewer.dissectionHint: Slide to remove layers, from skin to bone. Click a piece in any visible layer to open it.
viewer.isolateNeedsSelection: Select a piece to isolate it

structure.noPathologies: No diseases are linked to this structure yet.
structure.noMedia: No images for this structure yet. Got photos of specimens or radiographs under a free license? Contribute.
structure.untranslated: This entry is not translated to English yet; showing the Spanish version. Help translate it.
structure.illustrative: This piece is a schematic shape, not a scan: there is no freely licensed model for this structure yet.

review.draft: Draft, not yet reviewed by a veterinarian
review.draftHelp: Content may contain errors. It is published so the community can review it.
review.sourced: Based on sources, pending veterinary review
review.sourcedHelp: Every statement is checked against the references listed at the end. A veterinarian has not signed it yet.

search.placeholder: Search a bone, a disease or a Latin name…
search.hint: Type to search. Enter opens the entry.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: The page could not be displayed. You can retry or go back home.
errors.notFoundTitle: We could not find that page
errors.notFoundBody: The structure or disease may have been renamed. Search with ⌘K or go back home.

seo.homeTitle: Vet Atlas · Interactive 3D veterinary anatomy atlas
seo.homeDescription: A free, open 3D atlas of veterinary anatomy for students. Explore the dog, cat, cow and horse bone by bone, muscle by muscle and organ by organ, with Latin (NAV) names, descriptions and related diseases.
seo.speciesDescription: {species} ({latin}) in interactive 3D: {systems}. A free, open atlas for veterinary students.
seo.systemDescription: Explore {count} structures of the {species} {system} in interactive 3D, with Latin (NAV) names, descriptions and related diseases.
